sections.content: Tests require immutable hash-bound RED evidence, execution fingerprints that ignore reporting metadata, and terminal closure that references predecessor RED evidence without copying it.
sections.title: Stage evidence

sections.content: Tests require persisted and derived stage routing through implement, green, refactor, and terminal states; successor runs may reuse only hash-bound prior RED evidence. Cutover guards require the staged runner and immutable receipt successors.
sections.title: Recovery and cutover

sections.content: The three slices establish stage summaries, lineage-aware recovery, and staged migration with dogfood. Commands run focused tests, the full adapter suite, dogfood, and terminal checks; legacy evidence is read-only after cutover.
